description: Work out the time limits the law sets in England for a parking or traffic notice from the dates printed on it: the reduced-amount period, formal representations, when a council's Notice to Owner may come and the latest it may come, the tribunal, POPLA or IAS after a rejection, and whether a private Notice to Keeper came too late for the keeper to be liable. Each date errs early and comes with its legal source. The notice itself is authoritative.

event_date.description: The date of the parking or contravention, yyyy-mm-dd. Needed to check a private Notice to Keeper's timing.

notice_date.description: The date printed on the first notice (the PCN, the private Notice to Keeper, or the ticket on the car), yyyy-mm-dd.

notice_to_keeper_date.description: After a private ticket on the car: the printed date of the Notice to Keeper that came by post, yyyy-mm-dd.

notice_to_owner_date.description: A council Notice to Owner's printed date, yyyy-mm-dd, if one has come.

notice_type.description: council_pcn_on_vehicle: a council PCN put on the car or handed over. council_parking_pcn_by_post: a council parking PCN sent by post from camera evidence. council_bus_lane_or_moving_traffic: a bus lane, box junction, banned turn or similar PCN sent by post. private_no_ticket_on_vehicle: a private company's Notice to Keeper sent by post, no ticket on the car. private_ticket_on_vehicle: a private company's ticket left on the car.

rejection_date.description: The date of the letter refusing the challenge, yyyy-mm-dd, if there is one.

name: calculate_deadlines
title: Work out the deadlines on a notice
